title: Las Vegas: Death Valley Sunset and Stargazing Day Tour

cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Don’t just see the desert, master it. With over 10 years of professional guiding, I lead you through the raw, cinematic extremes of the lowest, hottest, and driest National Park in the contiguous U.S.

The Itinerary:

Dante’s View: A jaw-dropping 5,475ft panorama of the valley floor.

Badwater Basin: Walk the surreal salt flats at the lowest point in North America.

Artist’s Palette: Marvel at hills painted in volcanic pinks, teals, and golds.

Zabriskie Point: Catch the legendary Golden Hour across the rugged badlands.

The Grand Finale: As night falls, witness the "Gold Tier" Dark Sky. Experience a galaxy of stars and the Milky Way like never before.

Why book with me? A decade of desert expertise means secret spots, perfect timing, and stories you won't find in a guidebook. Skip the crowds; witness the magic. Ready for the adventure of a lifetime?
